svg.title: Aspect method development
svg.desc: FinBERT sentence embeddings are reduced with UMAP and clustered with HDBSCAN; the clusters were labelled into ten aspects. Seed-centroid assignment by cosine similarity was calibrated against the human aspect labels and found weak at any floor. A local LLM choosing one aspect from a fixed list was evaluated on the same labels and was far better, more so where two models agree; an LLM rater gives a reference. The answers of llama3.1:8b for the whole corpus, with the wealth aspect's narrower wording, were applied to the database.
